concerns.text: FR-004 and SC-005 require the system to HALT if <100 epochs/condition. Task T014 logic is contradictory: it states 'HALT if <100' but then immediately says 'flag as underpowered if <100... and exit'. This implies a continuation or a different exit path for the same threshold, failing to strictly enforce the '≥100' requirement defined in the spec's Independent Test and SC-005.

T039 mandates removing all fallback logic to 'Fail Loudly' on download failure. This contradicts spec.md 'Edge Cases' and 'Assumptions' which explicitly require the system to 'fall back to landmark interaction timestamps' if attention shift markers are absent. The task forces a hard stop on a recovery path defined as valid in the spec, leaving the FR-001/Edge Case requirement unimplemented.

T018 specifies computing Morlet wavelets on 'beta and low-gamma' bands. Spec.md FR-005 and FR-006 explicitly restrict the analysis to 'alpha (8-12 Hz) and beta (13-30 Hz)'. The inclusion of 'low-gamma' is an untagged scope expansion not covered by any FR/SC, leaving the specific frequency range requirement partially unimplemented and potentially violating the research question.

T029 implements FWE correction but does not explicitly tag or describe the restriction to 'alpha (8-12 Hz) at P3/Pz/P4 and beta (13-30 Hz) at F3/Fz/F4' as mandated by FR-009 and SC-004. Without this explicit constraint in the task description, the implementation risks applying correction to the wrong feature set (e.g., all electrodes), leaving the specific FR-009 requirement unverified.

Tasks T010 through T017 are all marked [P] (parallel) and target the single file `code/preprocessing.py`. While the note acknowledges 'Single-File Parallelism' risks, the lack of explicit modularization tasks (e.g., 'Create distinct function stubs for filter, ICA, epoch') means the parallel execution plan is not fully supported by the task breakdown, creating a high risk of merge conflicts that blocks the implementation of the underlying FRs.
